features.title: Ask and answer a child-agent question
features.summary: A child asks its direct parent with bounded context and a recommendation policy; only the parent can deliver the answer.
failureModes: A duplicate operation carries conflicting answer data.

verification.testName: returns a stable question id for a duplicate operation
rejects an answer from any Agent except the recorded direct parent
keeps a pending question answerable across Host shutdown and durable reopen
interrupts Host waiters without cancelling their durable question

features.title: Resolve question expiry safely
features.summary: Expiry either returns the recommended choice or writes a private deferred Markdown record without treating it as an answer.
failureModes: Unsafe path, symlink, or overwrite is rejected.
Repeated defer does not create duplicate records.

verification.testName: uses the recommended option when a question reaches its persisted deadline
writes private, fenced, idempotent workspace files
does not follow a workspace questions symlink
reattaches to a deferred outcome and file path after JSON domain reopen

features.title: Submit and resolve anchored Markdown feedback
features.summary: Submit line-anchored feedback against the current document revision and deliver accepted, rejected, or deferred resolution receipts to the child.
failureModes: A changed, unreadable, or unsafe Markdown target makes the receipt stale.
Feedback delivery failure is reported without applying stale content.

verification.testName: records batch resolutions with current or stale revision receipts
turns a previously current receipt stale if the document changes before retrieval
captures exact workspace lines against the whole-file revision
rejects traversal, symlinks, and a quote that does not match the source lines
preserves anchored feedback and late resolution receipts across JSON domain reopen

features.title: Resolve feedback in bounded batches
features.summary: Accept at most twenty feedback resolutions atomically and reject oversized batches before writing any receipt.
failureModes: A batch above the maximum is rejected before mutation.
A stale target cannot be automatically re-anchored.

verification.testName: accepts batches of 20 and rejects larger batches before resolving any item

features.title: Steady countdown and compact native question card
features.summary: Restyles the native async question card: a tabular, fixed-width countdown, a header that stacks under 480px, and a question clamped to three lines that expands on hover or focus.
failureModes: The rules key on the native card's data-question-key attribute, element structure and CSS-module class suffixes, so a DSH update that reshapes the card drops them silently.
Without DOM access there is no "Show more" button; the clamped question expands only on hover or keyboard focus inside the header.

verification.reason: The card only renders while a model turn calls ask_user_question, which dshx dev reach steps cannot trigger; check it on a live question at 800px and 420px pane widths.

features.title: List and answer thread questions
features.summary: Root Agents can list timed native questions across Sessions or by id, plus direct-child durable questions, with recommendation, timeout, and answerability metadata. Continued native forms and parent-scoped child questions use their authorized answer tools.
failureModes: A non-root Agent attempts cross-thread native access.
An open native form remains on the answerer waterfall or its target root is not live.
The Session projection is unavailable or a legacy-schema question has no timed projection.

verification.testName: lists pending questions by direct parent with exact deadline and child filter
records a timed deadline, continues after a pending result, then settles on reply
marks continued native forms answerable only for live root Sessions
